body:
> @Haroenv If you refine an item in a RefinementList, it calls the `events` endpoint twice:
>
> ```
> * RefinementList: filter clicked
>
> * Hits: viewed
> ```
>
> My point was that we should (at some point) batch these two in a single network request.

@francoischalifour I missed your feedback before.

(1) When a page is rendered, `view` event will be sent from hits/infiniteHits.
(2) And when user clicks on refinementList, then `click` will be sent.

There should be a time gap between (1) and (2).
(1) is programmatic and (2) is triggered by user action.

If there are a bunch of events sent programmatically, then we could batch them in a bucket of 1 second or something like that. For example, if a user has multiple hits or infiniteHits widgets on a single page, then multiple `view` events could be sent.

Let me know what you think. We can improve this later including more opinions :)
